Marco Rubio Discusses US-India Ties and Pakistan

US Senator Marco Rubio stated that India and the United States share the same concerns regarding terrorism, in comments made during an interview with India Today. He also addressed the US relationship with Pakistan, indicating that Washington's ties with Islamabad are viewed in the context of shared concerns. When asked about potential tariff advantages for India, Rubio responded in the same interview. Separately, Rubio defended changes to US work visa rules, stating they are not aimed at India but are intended to prioritize "America First."
